cadus.name: Cadus
cadus.description: A lone Tenno once used this staff to fight back a horde of Infested.

cassowar.name: Cassowar
cassowar.description: Light and nimble, the twin blades of this polearm will swoop and slice through throngs of hardened foes.

caustacyst.name: Caustacyst
caustacyst.description: Heavy attacks from this scythe unleash a wave of acid that mutilates enemies and leaves a trail of corrosive sludge.

ceramic-dagger.name: Ceramic Dagger
ceramic-dagger.description: This short blade weapon was built using ceramic. It has limited range but comes out fast.

cerata.name: Cerata
cerata.description: Twisted and tortured from exposure to the Infestation, this glaive becomes an absolute predator in the hands of the right Tenno.

ceti-lacera.name: Ceti Lacera
ceti-lacera.description: Forged for veterans of the Scarlet Spear conflict, this Lacera has been modified to enhance nimbleness and lethality.

cobra-crane.name: Cobra & Crane
cobra-crane.description: Baruuk's signature weapons: a sword for retribution, a shield for restraint. In Baruuk's hands, and his hands only, Cobra's first strike in a combo renders his foe unconscious.

cobra-crane-prime.name: Cobra & Crane Prime
cobra-crane-prime.description: Punish those who test your restraint. The first strike in a combo stuns enemies when Cobra & Crane Prime are wielded by Baruuk.

coda-caustacyst.name: Coda Caustacyst
coda-caustacyst.description: The Coda Caustacyst scythe is a force to be reckoned with, the Technocyte virus honing it with improved Damage, Status Chance, and Critical Damage, as well as acid pools with longer duration.

coda-hirudo.name: Coda Hirudo
coda-hirudo.description: Rip and shred your enemies to pieces with the Coda Hirudo. With improved Damage, Status Chance, Critical Chance, and Critical Damage.

coda-mire.name: Coda Mire
coda-mire.description: The Plague Year of 1999 will never be the same. With improved Critical Multipler, Critical Chance, and Status Chance, the Technocyte virus has turned the Coda Mire into a truly horrifying blade.

coda-motovore.name: Coda Motovore
coda-motovore.description: Drive home the pain with this hammer evolved from a scooter assembly. The wheel shapeshifts and gains a unique buff to match whatever type of physical damage it has been modded for.

coda-pathocyst.name: Coda Pathocyst
coda-pathocyst.description: Enhanced by Technocyte mutations, the Coda Pathocyst comes with increased Damage, Critical Chance, Critical Damage and Status Chance. While in-flight or on contact with the enemy, it will occasionally spawn enhanced, enemy-seeking miasmites.

corufell.name: Corufell
corufell.description: Heavy attacks briefly transform the Corufell into a Gunblade. After the Gunblade fires, the Corufell returns to its Heavy Scythe state. Its transformation is fastest in Citrine's hands.

corufell-prime.name: Corufell Prime
corufell-prime.description: Corufell Prime's golden vines streamline its transformation for even faster Heavy Attacks.

cronus.name: Cronus
cronus.description: A strong blade forged using ceramic.
